0022600095.text: Neither team has a 2026-27 record yet, and this is the Pacers' second game of the season, played at home against the Mavericks. In 2025-26 the Pacers lost their two meetings with Dallas 0-2, most recently 134-130 in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026. Indiana is missing Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), while Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee) and Tarik Biberovic (heel).
